scope: All four Table 3 pastes (control CP and 0.1, 0.5 and 1% EOGO by metakaolin mass) with exact batch masses, and their Table 4 initial and final setting times. Compressive strength, stiffness, voids and flow are reported as percentages, in figures or without mix names and are not transcribed.

materials.name: Metakaolin
materials.detail: Metakaolin (MK) is a pozzolanic material containing 49.1% silica (SiO2) and 43.2% alumina (Al2O3). The mean particle size of metakaolin is 11 μm.

materials.name: Edge-Oxidized Graphene Oxide
materials.detail: EOGO was procured from Garmor, Inc. (Orlando, FL, USA), and the chemical composition of EOGO is given in Table 2.

findings.text: The specimen with 0.1% EOGO (MKGO 0.1) showed the highest compressive strength.

notes.text: The results for the MKGO 0.5 specimen were not plotted due to problems with cracks occurring during the experiment.

gaps: Table quotes follow the standard form. The control is "CP" in the tables and "CS" in the strength and absorption text; both are recorded as the same mix.
The NaOH (SHS) and silicate (SSS) solution concentrations are not stated.
Compressive strength is plotted (Figure 6) and given in the text only as a 14.2% gain for MKGO 0.1 over the control at 28 days; stiffness, voids and toughness (no unit) likewise.

Flow diameters (407.50, 395.33, 388.33 and 381.67 mm) are listed with "respectively" in a sentence that names no pastes; water-absorption values are given as "rate … mm" without a defined unit. Neither is transcribed.
